evidence: Modifies the libbitcoinkernel public C API in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h and implementation in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp, replacing string log callbacks with structured btck_LogEntry objects.
rationale: This PR provides substantial durable value to downstream consumers by replacing brittle string parsing with structured log objects and removing logging.cpp from the kernel library. Delivering message contents, thread names, timestamps, and levels directly in btck_LogEntry eliminates the need for consumers to parse strings ('cumbersome, brittle, and inefficient'), advances decoupling of node internals from the kernel, and enables subsequent kernel refactors #30342 and #33847.
